A '''Hover-scoot''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] [[scooter]]. [[BanthaQuik!]] employees used them to deliver food to their patrons,<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref> and one and two-man hover-scoots could be rented on [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|Zirtran's Anchor]] for personal transport around the station.<ref name="ZA">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref>
